terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.preamble: These Terms of Service (hereinafter "Terms") govern access to and use of the Level Up application (hereinafter "the Application"), published by Level Up SAS. By accessing the Application, you unconditionally accept these Terms.

object.title: Purpose of the Application
object.content:
Level Up is an AI-powered personalized sports coaching application. It offers tailored training programs, progress tracking, voice coaching, and posture analysis.

The Application is not a substitute for professional medical advice. It is recommended to consult a healthcare professional before starting any exercise program.

access.title: Access to the Service
access.content:
The Application is available for free in its basic version. A Premium plan is available via monthly subscription.

Level Up reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue all or part of the service at any time and without notice, for maintenance or improvement purposes.

account.title: User Account
account.content:
Using the Application requires creating a personal account. You agree to:

• Provide accurate and up-to-date information
• Keep your credentials confidential
• Not share your account with third parties
• Notify Level Up of any unauthorized use

You are responsible for all activity on your account.

healthData.title: Health Data
healthData.content:
The Application collects and processes data related to your physical condition (performance, measurements, fitness goals). This data is considered health data under the GDPR (Article 9).

Processing is based on your explicit consent, obtained during registration. You may withdraw this consent at any time (see our Privacy Policy).

This data is processed with enhanced security measures in compliance with applicable regulations.

usage.title: Usage Rules
usage.content:
You agree to use the Application fairly and in accordance with its intended purpose. The following are prohibited:

• Attempting to bypass security measures
• Using the Application for unlawful purposes
• Copying, modifying, or redistributing content
• Creating fake accounts or impersonating others
• Disrupting the operation of the service

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content:
All elements of the Application (logo, design, text, algorithms, source code) are the exclusive property of Level Up SAS and are protected by intellectual property law.

Any unauthorized reproduction, representation, or use is strictly prohibited.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content:
Level Up endeavors to ensure the reliability of the Application. However, Level Up shall not be held liable for:

• Injuries sustained during exercise
• Temporary service interruptions
• Accuracy of AI-generated recommendations
• Damages resulting from non-compliant use

Use of the Application is at your own risk.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content:
You may delete your account at any time from the Application settings.

Level Up reserves the right to suspend or delete an account in case of violation of these Terms, without notice or compensation.

modifications.title: Modifications to the Terms
modifications.content: Level Up reserves the right to modify these Terms. Users will be notified of any substantial changes. Continued use of the Application after notification constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

law.title: Governing Law
law.content: These Terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, and after an attempt at amicable resolution, the competent courts shall be those of the jurisdiction of the registered office of Level Up SAS.

contact.content:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.preamble: Protecting your personal data is a priority for Level Up. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR - EU 2016/679).
privacy.rgpdBadge: Compliant with the European General Data Protection Regulation

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.content:
The data controller is:

Level Up SAS
Registered office: Paris, France
Email: contact@app-levelup.fr

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following categories of data:

• Identification data: first name, last name, email address
• Login data: password (encrypted), login logs
• Sports profile data: sport practiced, level, goals
• Health data: physical performance, mobility/stability/range tests, measurements, post-session feedback
• Usage data: pages visited, features used

healthData.title: Health Data (Special Category)
healthData.content:
In accordance with Article 9 of the GDPR, data related to your physical condition is special category data requiring explicit consent.

This data includes:
• Physical test results (mobility, stability, range of motion)
• Sports performance and progress
• Subjective post-session feedback (pain, fatigue, difficulty)

Legal basis: your explicit consent (Article 9.2.a of the GDPR), obtained during registration via a dedicated checkbox.

You may withdraw this consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

legalBasis.title: Legal Bases for Processing
legalBasis.content:
Depending on the purposes, our processing is based on:

• Explicit consent: health data, non-essential cookies
• Contract performance: account management, service delivery
• Legitimate interest: service improvement, security
• Legal obligation: billing, legal retention

purposes.title: Processing Purposes
purposes.content:
Your data is used to:

• Create and manage your user account
• Generate personalized AI training programs
• Track your progress and adapt recommendations
• Provide voice coaching services
• Ensure the security and proper functioning of the Application
• Improve our algorithms and service quality

Your data is never used for third-party marketing.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content:
• Account data: retained during your registration, deleted within 30 days of account deletion
• Health data: retained during your registration, deleted immediately upon account deletion or consent withdrawal
• Login logs: 12 months (legal obligation)
• Billing data: 10 years (accounting obligation)

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content:
Your personal data is never sold.

It may be shared with:
• Our technical subcontractors (hosting, infrastructure) under GDPR-compliant contracts
• Competent authorities when legally required

All our subcontractors are located within the European Union or in countries ensuring an adequate level of protection.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
• Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure: request deletion of your data
• Right to portability: receive your data in a structured format
• Right to object: object to certain processing
• Right to restriction: limit the processing of your data
• Right to withdraw consent: at any time for health data

To exercise your rights, contact our DPO at: contact@app-levelup.fr
Response time: 30 days maximum.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content:
The Application uses only essential technical cookies for the proper functioning of the service (authentication, language preferences).

No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

security.title: Security
security.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:

• Password encryption (bcrypt)
• Encrypted communications (HTTPS/TLS)
• Restricted access to health data
• Regular and secure backups
• Regular security testing

minors.title: Minors
minors.content: The Application is intended for persons aged 16 and over. For minors under 16, the consent of a legal representative is required in accordance with Article 8 of the GDPR.

changes.title: Changes
changes.content: This policy may be updated. In case of substantial changes, you will be notified via the Application or by email. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of this document.

dpo.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
dpo.content:
For any questions regarding the protection of your data:

DPO Level Up
Email: contact@app-levelup.fr
Address: Level Up SAS, Paris, France

We commit to responding to any request within 30 days.

cnil.title: Complaint to the Supervisory Authority
cnil.content:
If you believe that the processing of your data does not comply with regulations, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority:

CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés)
3 Place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715
75334 Paris Cedex 07
www.cnil.fr
